tree_sha256_method: find . -type f -name '*.txt' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256, run in this directory
notes: Chia's official CLVM command tests, vendored verbatim from the release tag matching the pinned clvm wheel. Each .txt file holds optional leading # comments, one brun command line, and the expected stdout: 'cost = N' when -c is given, then the printed result, or a 'FAIL: message' line. Expectations were produced by clvm_tools brun over the Python clvm package, so FAIL messages and the negative-division deprecation are that library's spellings of the shared semantics. tools/run_upstream.py re-derives every expectation semantically against bitlisp and the consensus oracle instead of comparing stdout text.
